assembly_steps.instructions: Box body: bottom to the top of the Base plinth (fixed).

assembly_steps.instructions: Top plate: bottom to the top of the Box body (fixed); Drawer front: back to the front of the Box body (on its slide); Front badge plate: back to the front of the Box body (fixed).

assembly_steps.instructions: Drawer knob stem: back to the front of the Drawer front (fixed).
assembly_steps.title: Attach Drawer knob stem to the Drawer front

assembly_steps.instructions: Dome flange ring: bottom to the top of the Top plate (fixed); Top plate screw NE: bottom to the top of the Top plate (fixed); Top plate screw NW: bottom to the top of the Top plate (fixed); Top plate screw SE: bottom to the top of the Top plate (fixed); Top plate screw SW: bottom to the top of the Top plate (fixed).
assembly_steps.title: Attach Dome flange ring, Top plate screw NE, Top plate screw NW and 2 more to the Top plate

assembly_steps.instructions: Polished dome: bottom to the top of the Dome flange ring (fixed); Flange screw N: bottom to the top of the Dome flange ring (fixed); Flange screw S: bottom to the top of the Dome flange ring (fixed); Flange screw E: bottom to the top of the Dome flange ring (fixed); Flange screw W: bottom to the top of the Dome flange ring (fixed).

assembly_steps.instructions: Drawer pull cap: back to the front of the Drawer knob stem (fixed).

visual_goal.description: Compact square wooden box grinder with chrome dome lid, lateral crank and small front drawer face.
signature_features: Square wooden box body with rounded edges and base plinth
Polished metal dome with circular flange and central spindle
Side crank arm with spherical wooden knob
Front pull-out drawer front with round metal pull
Small badge on the front face
Exposed screws around the flange and on the top plate corners

issues.proposed_change: Adjust dome geometry to be flatter and more rounded like the reference.

issues.observed: Crank length is too disproportionate and thick.
issues.proposed_change: Adjust crank arm to be thinner and aligned properly to avoid overlapping with the central spindle visually.
issues.target: Crank should be slimmer and positioned lower.

issues.observed: Lack of surface detail and edge definition.
issues.proposed_change: Add texture to the box body surface and sharpen the edges to match the reference.
issues.target: Box body should show wood grain texture and more defined edges.

issues.proposed_change: Model the screws on the top plate around the dome flange similar to the reference.
issues.target: Screws should be visible around the dome flange.

issues.observed: Missing branding badge on the front.
issues.proposed_change: Include the badge/logo on the front face of the box body above the drawer.
issues.target: Reference shows a badge/logo above the drawer.

issues.observed: Crank orientation is misaligned in perspective view.
issues.proposed_change: Position the crank arm horizontally and adjust the knob to match the original's position.
issues.target: Crank should align horizontally when viewed in perspective.

image_observations: Object is a compact square wooden box with rounded top edges and a slightly overhanging top plate.
A shiny, low chrome dome sits centered on top; small hinged slot visible on dome.
Straight metal crank arm extends laterally with a spherical amber-toned knob.
Front face has a small pull-out drawer with a round metal pull knob; badge centered above drawer.
Visible screws around the dome flange and on the wood top; light wear/staining on wood.
Coffee beans scattered near the base; neutral studio background; silhouette reads as a cube with a horizontal arm.

Steel shaft, nuts, and adjustment screw
mechanical_constraints: Burr alignment concentricity is critical to avoid wobble and uneven grind.
Shaft support/bushing must minimize friction while tolerating coffee dust.
Drawer must fit with low leakage but easy pull force; add stop to prevent full drop.
Crank clearance above lid and knob diameter must avoid knuckle collisions with dome.
Fastener joints must resist cyclic torque; wood threads may need inserts.
Top opening should limit bean escape/back-spill during fast cranking.
